title: First-factor tensor shift-one reassociation on three K-flat representatives
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with the recorded K-flat derived tensor on $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and its canonical tensor shifts [def-sc-scheme-canonical-tensor-shift]. Let $P,T,U$ be K-flat complexes of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Put $A=Q(P)$, $K=Q(T)$, $M=Q(U)$ for the derived localization. Write $s_B(1)_A:A[1]\otimes B\to(A\otimes B)[1]$ for the canonical first-variable shift-one comparison. Then $s_{K\otimes M}(1)_A;\alpha_{A,K,M}^{-1}[1]=\alpha_{A[1],K,M}^{-1};(s_K(1)_A\otimes\mathrm{id}_M);s_M(1)_{A\otimes K}$, where semicolons compose from left to right. This asserts no square at arbitrary derived objects and no shift other than one.

source.place: Canonical K-flat total tensor translation; translated-unit calculation of the parent plan

proof.text: Prove the homogeneous-summand total-complex coherence using lem-sc-total-tensor-shift-one-associator. This part is fully proved in Lean, without K-flatness.

Apply the two independent normalization formulas of lem-sc-scheme-tensor-shift-localization-normalization. Install its IsIso target comparison, postcompose both forward derived routes by that comparison, rewrite the two normalizations and the proved complex equality, and cancel the comparison. Precompose and postcompose by the appropriate associator isomorphisms to turn this forward square into the unchanged inverse-associator statement. All cancellation and the combination of parts are proved in Lean.

proof_origin.place: Representative-complex plan: summand coherence proved; independent localization normalizations isolated; comparison cancellation and conversion to the inverse-associator square proved by H1.

theorem schemeCanonicalTensorShift_associator_kFlat_one (X : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (P T U : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
    (hT : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) T)
    (hU : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := X.sheaf) U) :
    letI := schemeCanonicalTensorShift X
    letI : ∀ B : schemeDerivedCategory X, (tensorRight B).CommShift ℤ :=
      fun B ↦ Functor.CommShift₂.commShiftFlipObj (h := .int) B
    let A := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj T
    let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj U
    ((tensorRight (K ⊗ M)).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app A ≫
        (α_ A K M).inv⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' =
      (α_ (A⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) K M).inv ≫
        (((tensorRight K).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app A) ▷ M ≫
        ((tensorRight M).commShiftIso (1 : ℤ)).hom.app (A ⊗ K)
